title.zh: 地理空间资产数据分析员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain geospatial asset layers and document the evidence for proposed edits.
requirements.zh: 维护地理空间资产图层，并记录拟议编辑的依据。

requirements.en: Use SQL to reconcile asset identifiers and distinguish record rows from distinct assets.
requirements.zh: 使用 SQL 核对资产编号，并区分记录行与不同资产。

requirements.en: Communicate changes clearly and work within survey approval and publication controls.
requirements.zh: 清晰沟通变更，并遵守测绘审批与发布控制。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently design and deploy automated Python geospatial pipelines.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立设计并部署自动化 Python 地理空间处理流程。
